alertas_do_dia.titulo: INTC · Why Intel Stock Is Down After Weak Q4 Guidance
corpo: Yahoo Finance · 02/11 20h16 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):

– - Intel reported Q3 2026 sales of US$16,513 million with net income of US$3,320 million, and issued Q4 guidance calling for US$15.0 billion to US$16.0 billion in revenue and US$0.10 in diluted EPS attributable to Intel.

– - Management attributed the weaker Q4 outlook to soft PC demand, memory shortages, and production disruptions including a shutdown at its Israel facility, while demand for Xeon server and AI chips remained strong.
– - We will now examine how Intel's weaker Q4 outlook and PC headwinds could reshape the longer term investment narrative around AI.
– The big swing factor is still whether those US$20b plus annual capex levels convert into profitable Xeon and foundry volumes rather than just unused fabs that weigh on cash flow.
– The Q4 reset puts a bright spotlight on that question, because it shows how quickly demand can clash with supply bottlenecks and outages.
– The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure agreement around current and future Intel Xeon platforms, including the planned Diamond Rapids based X14 instances, ties directly into that catalyst and risk pair.
Link: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-intel-stock-down-weak-231626988.html

– No levantamento do Money Times anterior à reunião de setembro, o banco estava entre as quatro casas que esperavam esse patamar para dezembro, enquanto dez projetavam juros de 13,75%.
– No relatório assinado pela economista-chefe Rafaela Vitória, o Inter reconhece que o Banco Central pode antecipar a pausa e manter a taxa nos atuais 13,75%.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: VALE3 · Vale (VALE3) tem lucro de US$ 1,25 bi no 3T26, queda de 53% em um ano
corpo: Suno Noticias · 30/10 10h51 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– Negócios Vale (VALE3) tem lucro de US$ 1,25 bi no 3T26, queda de 53% em um ano A Vale (VALE3) registrou um lucro líquido atribuível aos acionistas de US$ 1,255 bilhão no terceiro trimestre de 2026.
– O valor representa uma retração de 53% em relação ao mesmo intervalo de 2025.
– Frente ao segundo trimestre deste ano, o recuo foi de 9%.
– O balanço foi publicado pela Vale na quinta-feira (29), depois do encerramento do pregão.
– O consenso compilado pela LSEG projetava lucro de US$ 1,38 bilhão para o período.
– A receita líquida de vendas alcançou US$ 10,6 bilhões entre julho e setembro, avanço de 2% sobre o 3T25.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: VALE3 · Vale não prevê dividendos extraordinários em 2026, diz CFO
corpo: CNN Brasil · 30/10 13h24 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– A Vale não prevê o pagamento de dividendos extraordinários em 2026, diante das incertezas geopolíticas esperadas para o próximo ano.

– A informação foi dada nesta sexta-feira (30) pelo vice-presidente executivo de Finanças e Relações com Investidores da companhia, Marcelo Bacci, durante teleconferência sobre os resultados do terceiro trimestre.
– "Preferimos ficar do lado conservador para lidarmos com as medidas incertas", afirmou Bacci.
– A Vale mantém em aberto um programa de recompra de até 100 milhões de ações, aprovado pelo Conselho de Administração em julho deste ano.
– "Temos um programa de recompra em aberto, para recomprar até 100 milhões de ações.
– Isso dá oportunidade para recomprar", disse.
Link: https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/infra/vale-nao-preve-dividendos-extraordinarios-em-2026-diz-cfo/

alertas_do_dia.titulo: INTC · Intel Sinks 29% as Weak Outlook Shows It’s “Still PC Dependent”
corpo: Yahoo Finance · 30/10 10h39 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– Key Takeaways - Intel shares fell 29% after it guided fourth-quarter revenue to $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion on a faster PC slump.
– - Data center revenue grew 78% in the third quarter, but Intel can't make enough server chips to offset weaker PC sales.
– - Intel's case now rests on adding server supply in 2027.
– Rival Advanced Micro Devices (AMD:NASDAQ) fell [9%], and Micron Technology (MU:NASDAQ), whose memory chips sit at the root of the slump, lost [6%].
– Servers can't carry it yet Intel's third quarter beat its own guidance, with data center revenue up 78% to $7.3 billion while PC chip revenue fell 5%.
– But it guided fourth-quarter revenue to $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion and its non-GAAP gross margin to 38%, from 44.1%.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: JPM · JPMorgan Raises NII Outlook: Is JPM Stock Too Expensive?
corpo: Yahoo Finance · 30/10 09h30 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– JPMorgan JPM has raised its net interest income (NII) outlook for 2026, supported by steady loan growth, higher deposit balances and resilient customer activity.
– The banking giant also provided an encouraging preliminary NII outlook for 2027, suggesting that spread income momentum could continue into next year.
– In the third quarter of 2026, JPMorgan's NII increased 13% year over year to $27.1 billion.
– Following its third-quarter results, management raised its full-year 2026 total NII projection to approximately $106.2 billion from the previously expected $105.5 billion.
– Similarly, NII excluding Markets is now anticipated to reach approximately $97.2 billion, up from the earlier projection of $96.5 billion.
– For the fourth quarter, management expects total NII of roughly $28 billion and NII excluding Markets of $25.5 billion.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: INTC · Intel plunges on a major guidance miss. What went wrong — and how to proceed
corpo: CNBC · 29/10 22h06 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– Revenue in the third quarter increased 21% year over year to $16.513 billion, edging out the LSEG-compiled consensus estimate of $16.496 billion.
– Non-GAAP earnings per share (EPS) more than doubled to 52 cents, beating the LSEG estimate of 40 cents.
– As a result, our rating is currently under review, and we are slashing our price target to $100.

corpo: CNBC · 02/11 17h07 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):

– As Intel comes off its steepest stock drop since the 1970s due to a worsening outlook for the PC market, the chipmaker is facing intensifying pressure to get its flailing foundry business off the ground.
– The company has spent half a decade, and a good chunk of its $108 billion in capital expenditures over that stretch, trying to challenge Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company.

– government took a 10% stake in Intel in August 2025, and Nvidia followed with a $5 billion investment, the stock started to shoot up, ultimately rising sixfold over 10 months before peaking in June.
– The stock plummeted 29% on Friday, its worst day since the 1970s, capping off a 45% plunge in October, the steepest monthly drop on record, according to FactSet.
– It's down another 8% in Monday trading.
– CEO Lip-Bu Tan said he sees the global market for server processors increasing as much as five times over the next five years to about $200 billion.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: USDBRL · Câmbio deve pressionar expectativa de inflação no Copom, diz Pinheiro
corpo: CNN Brasil · 02/11 16h56 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– O Copom (Comitê de Política Monetária) do Banco Central decidirá a próxima taxa básica de juros na quarta-feira (4).
– Após o resultado do segundo turno das eleições, as expectativas do mercado financeiro migraram de um possível corte de 0,25 ponto na Selic para a manutenção da taxa no patamar atual de 13,75%.

– A economista destacou que o real se desvalorizou em relação ao dólar após o resultado eleitoral, com a taxa de câmbio rodando em torno de R$ 5,35 por dólar — patamar significativamente acima do verificado na última reun…
– Ela mencionou que o relatório Focus, que reúne a mediana das expectativa do mercado para uma série de indicadores, deve trazer aumento das expectativas inflacionárias para 2026 e 2027.
– Entre os fatores citados estão a defasagem no preço dos combustíveis, os impactos da reforma tributária sobre os preços e a possibilidade do fim da escala 6x1.

– "Esses dois pontos devem puxar a projeção de inflação do Banco Central para cima, deslocando de 3,2% para algo mais em torno de 3,5%", afirmou, referindo-se ao horizonte relevante do primeiro semestre de 2028.
Link: https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/economia/money/macroeconomia/cambio-deve-pressionar-expectativa-de-inflacao-no-copom-diz-pinheiro/

– Intel reported better-than-anticipated Q3 earnings after the bell Thursday, but provided Q4 revenue estimates of between $15 billion and $16 billion, well below analysts' projections of $17 billion.

– For the third quarter, analysts anticipate AMD to report earnings per share of $1.97 on revenue of $13 billion, according to Bloomberg consensus estimates.

– AMD's Data Center arm is expected to see sales of $8.19 billion, an 88% increase from the $4.34 billion it reported last year.
– The company's Client business revenue, which includes PC sales, is set to top $3.06 billion, up 11% year over year, but flat sequentially.

– Key Stats for Nvidia Stock - Current Price: $204.64 - Target Price (Mid): ~$500 - Street Target: ~$329 - Potential Total Return: ~145% - Annualized IRR: ~23% / year What Happened?
– Nvidia (NVDA:NASDAQ) fell 4.22% to $204.64 on October 30 as Intel's weak outlook and Amazon's results revived doubts about AI spending and dragged chip stocks lower.
– Wall Street's revenue forecast for Nvidia's fiscal year ending January 2028 is up 25% since June 30, while the stock sits close to its $206.84 level at the end of the July quarter.

– Separately, an October 30 notice listed Nvidia among 50 companies objecting to tokenized versions of their stock on ICE and OKX's planned 24/7 venue, a decision about where its shares trade, not what it earns.
– The Price Stood Still In TIKR's consensus data, fiscal 2028 revenue rose from about $554 billion on June 30 to about $692 billion on November 2.
– Coverage barely changed, from 55 analysts to 57, so that rise reflects revisions rather than new forecasters.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: BTC · Crypto Hack Losses Hit $8.74 in 2026, More Than Triple 2025, Yet Without Binance the Year Ran Quieter: How Did Bitcoin and Ethereum React After Major…
corpo: Yahoo Finance · 02/11 10h10 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– Crypto Hack Losses Hit $8.74 in 2026, More Than Triple 2025, Yet Without Binance the Year Ran Quieter: How Did Bitcoin and Ethereum React After Major Hacks?

– Crypto hack losses reached $8.74 billion in 2026 by October 31, more than three times the $2.51 billion lost over the same ten months of 2025, after the October 29 Binance breach alone added $6.36 billion.
– The rest of 2026 comes to $2.38 billion, about 5% less than 2025 at the same point, even though attackers hit 325 targets against 120 a year earlier.
– Across the ten largest hacks since January 2025, Bitcoin's move on the day of the attack ranged from -4.1% to +1.9%.
– A month later, for the nine with a full month of data, the range ran from -15.5% to +19.9%, and it followed whatever the broader market was doing.
– The 2025 hacks landed in falling markets, and every one was followed by a lower Bitcoin price a month later.
Link: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/crypto-hack-losses-hit-8-131017031.html

– - Lumentum also reported $1.26 billion in first-quarter revenue, beating estimates.
– Marvell (MRVL) on Monday announced a $115 billion all-stock deal to acquire Lumentum (LITE), with Marvell CEO Matt Murphy calling it a "once in a generation" deal.
– "AI infrastructure is undergoing a fundamental architectural shift toward optical connectivity, creating an opportunity that comes along once in a generation," said Murphy.

– "The companies that move first and help define this transition will set the standard for decades to come" MRVL stock was up around 1% in pre-market trade, paring earlier gains, while LITE stock gained as much as 2.5%.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: CVX · Chevron reports net income of $9.9bn in Q3 2026
corpo: Yahoo Finance · 02/11 07h36 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– Chevron has reported net income of $9.92bn for the third quarter of 2026 (Q3 2026), a 180.4% increase from $3.54bn in the same period of 2025.
– Total revenues and other income rose 36.4% year-on-year to $67.8bn, compared to $49.7bn a year earlier.
– Reported earnings per diluted share rose by approximately 178% year-over-year, increasing from $1.82 to $5.06.
– Adjusted earnings for the quarter surged by about 189%, reaching $10.4bn compared to $3.6bn in the same period last year.
– Cash flow from operations (CFFO) grew by roughly 70%, climbing from $9.4bn a year ago to $16bn in the current quarter.
– Chevron said the Q3 2026 results were driven by stronger margins on refined products and increased crude oil prices, although rising prices led to some negative timing impacts.
